text:
sam: quick heads up - running the "edge-rag-starter" (next13 edge + LlamaIndex) and hitting weird 401 retries from the SDK when the app sits idle for ~30s. frontend shows final answer but logs show 3 quick retries and one final success, which spikes token counts in console.

sam: repro: clone github.com/redwood/samples/edge-rag-starter, yarn && vercel dev (edge), load page, wait 35s, send query. observability: request -> model node, but client shows 401 -> sdk retries -> success. not sure why token accounting counts the failed attempts.

jules: does the SDK attach the auth header on every fetch? edge runtimes sometimes drop headers on redirect or when using the fetch polyfill. which SDK version?

sam: @jules using "@redwood/inference-js": "0.11.0" from the template. code uses a singleton:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js';
Redwood.init({ apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_KEY });
export default async function edgeHandler(req) {
  const res = await Redwood.call({ model: 'llama-13b', input: req.json().q });
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(res));
}
```

nora: are you using NEXT_PUBLIC_ env for edge? that exposes key to client. but more importantly there was a bug in 0.11.0 where auth cookie refresh attempted a background refresh using a non-signed fetch which returned 401 and retried. fixed in 0.11.3.

sam: hmm we intentionally put the key in edge runtime env (not client), but template's example puts it in NEXT_PUBLIC for demo. doh. in our fork i moved it to server env var but didn't update the starter.

qa-bot: test run failing: integration/edge-retries.test.js -> observed 3 retries on cold path, expected 0. See job 4721.

jules: two action items: 1) change template to use server-only env var in code examples and README; 2) pin SDK in template to >=0.11.3; also add a tiny client-side telemetry badge to show retry counts so devs notice the extra attempts.

infra: note - retries will increment meter tokens because our billing counts attempted token emissions. if the SDK retries after partial token send we should ensure retries are idempotent or that server-metrics ignore 401 aborted streams. filing infra ticket to add an ingestion-side guard.

sam: for the immediate fix i cut patch on my branch: upgraded to 0.11.4 and swapped env usage, and added a middleware in the example: `if (Redwood._telemetry?.queue?.length === 0) console.warn(...)` and `await Redwood.telemetry.flush()` before returning in server handler. seems stable locally.

jules: great. please open a PR against samples with title "edge-rag-starter: pin sdk >=0.11.3, server env example, and retry docs". add CHANGES entry in sample README and a short note in devex playbook about how retries affect billing.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/samples/pull/2135 - includes tests that assert zero retry on idle path using node-fetch stub.

nora: adding to release notes: SDK 0.11.4 fixed retry auth race in edge runtimes. i'll coordinate with docs to surface the change in the SDK changelog so starter authors know.

qa-bot: created issue #1538 (devex) "edge-rag-starter: SDK retry/auth race + template env leakage" and linked PR 2135.

sam: thanks all. learned two things: don't use NEXT_PUBLIC for API keys in starters, and keep SDKs fresh. will follow up if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
